title: Whatever Happens: Defiance with *bármi … is*
grammar: Recap: *bármi … is* with the subjunctive, and *történjék bármi*
goal: I can say that I will not give way, whatever happens (*Történjék bármi, …*).
I can say 'whatever the authorities may do' (*bármilyen … hozzon is a hatalom*).
I can name non-compliance and resistance (*passzív rezisztencia*, *szembeszegül*).

sections.title: Unit 12: Civic Resistance, Dissent & Legal Philosophy
body: This unit is about civic resistance and dissent: not giving way, stating the ground of your stance, unjust laws, legality and legitimacy, and a judge's dissenting opinion.
The reading in lesson 5 is a text about the writer and sociologist Konrád György.
